data.title: Hamburger SV vs Bayern Munich predictions: Olise to shine | Goal.com Canada
data.content:
### Probable lineups for Hamburger SV vs Bayern Munich

Hamburger SV expected lineup: Fernandes, Capaldo, Bornauw, Omari, El Ouahdi, Gronbaek, Adeline, Muheim, Wolf, Moffi, Rossing-Lelesiit

Bayern Munich expected lineup: Urbig, Laimer, Upamecano, Kim, Stanisic, Kimmich, Pavlovic, Ito, Olise, Karl, Diaz [...] Bayern Munich have problems in attack. Top scorer Harry Kane will miss this game, as will Jamal Musiala, given his health concerns. Luis Diaz should play but has only just returned from injury, which puts the onus on Michael Olise. The Frenchman has already shown that he’s up to the task this season. [...] Kane’s case is far worse, as he’s expected to be out for months after tearing his ankle ligament, while Olise could return on Saturday. Vincent Kompany himself has only just returned to the dugout after his health concerns. He’s been greeted by a dire injury situation in Bavaria.

For the champions, bouncing back from that draw is imperative, which will help them maintain pressure on Dortmund. But a midweek loss to Lille doesn’t inspire confidence for them this weekend.
